name: Comprehend Language
description: Lets the user understand and/or communicate in a way they otherwise couldn't — a spoken/written language, or a normally-mute creature type.

mechanics.text: While active, the user can understand (and often speak with) something they otherwise couldn't — another spoken/written language, or beasts/plants/other normally-uncommunicative creatures. Which one lives in this record's own featureParams.understands, when the source names it specifically.
